evals.prompt: I want to build a set of motion graphics title cards for my product but I don't have a brand, a URL, or any existing design to go off. Can you help me put together a design system first?
evals.expected_output: Should recognize there's no reference material and run the guided question set (what it is, desired feel, light/dark, anchor color, type character, density, shape language, reference points, where it lives) as one batched set rather than one question at a time, before drafting anything. Should not invent a design system without asking first.
assertions: Identifies there is no reference material to extract from
Asks the guided question set rather than guessing a design
Asks the questions together as a batch, not one per turn
Does not draft DESIGN.md sections before getting answers

evals.prompt: Turn stripe.com's design into a DESIGN.md I can use for the on-screen graphics in my explainer video.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this as extraction from a live site, fetch/read the site's styles rather than guessing, and produce all 9 sections (theme, colors, typography, components, layout/spacing, elevation, do's/don'ts, responsive behavior, agent prompt guide) with concrete values (real hex codes, real pixel sizes) rather than vague descriptions.
assertions: Treats this as extraction from a live source rather than from-scratch design
Uses concrete hex/pixel values rather than vague adjectives
Includes an agent prompt guide with runnable example prompts
